title: Appeals accepted online only
what_goes_wrong: A mailed packet is treated as accepted although the issuer takes appeals online only.

title: Contest needs an in-person appearance
what_goes_wrong: Mail permission for mitigation or another step is reused as permission to contest by mail.
signals: must appear in person to petition

title: Paying ends the protest
what_goes_wrong: The customer is not told that paying the citation can give up the protest.
signals: Do not pay your citation if you wish to protest it

title: Deposit belongs to a later hearing
what_goes_wrong: A hearing deposit for a later stage is imposed on the first written protest.
signals: deposit equal to the amount of the fine in order to request a hearing

title: Full police report, not a number
what_goes_wrong: A police report number is sent where the issuer requires the complete report.
signals: not just the police report number

title: Written statement needs a scheduled hearing first
what_goes_wrong: A mailed statement is sent before the court has scheduled a hearing, and is not read.
signals: without an initial hearing scheduled will not be read

title: Re-appeal form admits responsibility
what_goes_wrong: A later-stage form's responsibility declaration bleeds into the first appeal.
signals: hereby accept responsibility for the parking citation

title: Hearing only after paying
what_goes_wrong: A later hearing that requires payment first is presented as the first appeal.
